sn11.2:1.1: Sāvatthiyam viharati Jetavane || || Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || || Bhikkhavo ti || || Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn11.2:2.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave asurā deve abhiyaṃsu || atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi || ete tāta Susīma asurā deve abhiyanti || gaccha tāta Susīma asure paccuyyāhīti || || Evam bhadanta vā ti kho bhikkhave Susīmo devaputto Sakassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā pamādam āpādesi || || Dutiyam pi kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmam devaputtam āmantesi || pa || dutiyam pi pamādam āpādesi || || Tatiyam pi kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmam devaputtam āmantesi || pa || tatiyam pi pamādam āpādesi || || Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn11.2:3.1: Anuṭṭhahaṃ avāyamaṃ || sukhaṃ yatrādhigacchati || || Susīma tattha gacchāhi || mañ ca tatth-eva pāpayā ti || ||
sn11.2:4.1: Alasassa anuṭṭhātā || na ca kiccāni kāraye || sabbakāmasamiddhassa || tam me Sakka varam disan ti || ||
sn11.2:5.1: Yatthālaso anuṭṭhātā || accantaṃ sukham edhati || Susīma tattha gacchāhi || mañca tatth-eva pāpayā ti || ||
sn11.2:6.1: Akammanā devaseṭṭha || Sakka vindemu yaṃ sukhaṃ || asokam anupāyāsaṃ || tam me Sakka varaṃ disan ti || ||
sn11.2:7.1: Sa ce atthi akammena || koci kvaci na jīyati || nibbānassa hi so maggo || Susīma tattha gacchāhi || mañca tatth-eva pāpayā ti || ||
sn11.2:8.1: So hi nāma bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo sakam puññaphalaṃ upajīvamāno devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānam issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjam karonto uṭṭhānaviriyassa vaṇṇavādī bhavissati || idha kho taṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākhyāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā uṭṭhaheyyātha ghaṭeyyātha vāyameyyātha appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā ti || ||
